description: It checks whether a page from somewhere else can be shown inside the live room, in the sidebar or as an overlay: whether that page allows being shown inside another page, and what would go wrong if it does not. Take it before a booking page or a checkout page goes into the room. "I want my booking page in the sidebar." A page that refuses shows the participants an empty box, and the host sees no error at all. You give the full address of the page. It changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: embed page, empty box, sidebar page, booking page

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

url.description: The full address of the page that should be shown inside the room.

name: wi_check_embedding
title: Check whether a page may be shown inside the room
